patches.before: 每个元素后面只连着 1 个元素
patches.after: 每个元素后面最多连着 1 个元素

patches.before: each element links to only one next element
patches.after: each element links to at most one next element

patches.before: トーナメント表のようなもの。どの試合も 2 つの枠から勝者が 1 人上がり、枝は常に二股以下に分かれる。
patches.after: はい / いいえで進む診断チャートのようなもの。1 つの質問から先は「はい」と「いいえ」の 2 方向までに分かれ、片方にしか続きがない質問や、そこで結果が出て終わる質問もある。
patches.reason: Rule A L2 比喩が子ちょうど 2 つの像

patches.before: 就像淘汰赛的对阵表。每场比赛都从两个位置中晋级一名胜者，分支始终最多分成两股。
patches.after: 就像按“是 / 否”往下走的诊断流程图。每个问题往下最多分成“是”和“否”两个方向，也有只有一边接着往下走的问题，或者到此给出结果、不再往下的问题。

patches.before: Think of a knockout tournament bracket. Every match sends one winner up from two slots, so a branch never splits into more than two.
patches.after: Think of a yes/no quiz chart. Each question leads on in at most two directions, yes and no; some questions continue on only one side, and some end there with a result.

patches.before: Take out the item stacked last first
patches.after: Last item stacked comes out first

patches.before: Take out the item added first first
patches.after: First item added comes out first
